issues.explanation: rejected_fa contains «امنیت دادههای شخصی» without ZWNJ; the editor_note_fa already spells it correctly with ZWNJ. Fix to «امنیت داده‌های شخصی».
issues.suggested_fix: In rejected_fa, replace «امنیت دادههای شخصی» with «امنیت داده‌های شخصی».

issues.explanation: The editor note claims «حریم اطلاعاتی» (information privacy) is a «زیرمجموعه» (subset) of «حریم خصوصی» «در همان بند», attributing a taxonomic relationship to INSO 23728 clause 4.1. The truncated evidence text from that clause discusses the distinction between information-privacy objectives and information-security objectives; it does not explicitly establish information privacy as a subset of privacy. The conceptual inference may be reasonable, but attributing it to the clause over-claims what the standard prints.
issues.suggested_fix: Soften the editor note: replace «زیرمجموعه‌ای از آن است» with a formulation that does not attribute the subset relationship to the clause — e.g. «مفهومی مرتبط و محدودتر است» — or drop the subset claim and simply note that both terms appear in the standard.

issues.explanation: The editor note correctly identifies the printed phrase as «سطح رواداری مخاطره» (INSO 23728 clauses 7.3.2 and 8.1) and states it was registered as an alternative, but alternatives_fa lists only «رواداری مخاطره» (without «سطح»). The verbatim printed phrase «سطح رواداری مخاطره» is missing from alternatives.
issues.suggested_fix: Add «سطح رواداری مخاطره» to alternatives_fa alongside the existing «رواداری مخاطره».

issues.explanation: Duplicate entry in rejected_fa: «آستانه پذیرش ریسک» appears twice.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicate «آستانه پذیرش ریسک» from rejected_fa.

issues.explanation: «سطح ریسکپذیری» in rejected_fa is missing the ZWNJ between «ریسک» and «پذیری».
issues.suggested_fix: Replace «سطح ریسکپذیری» with «سطح ریسک‌پذیری» in rejected_fa.

issues.explanation: definition_en has a stray quotation mark: it reads …risk" (Source: ISO 31000:2018)." — the trailing period-quote is malformed. The field already carries the 'NIST context:' label, so the internal quoting is redundant and introduces a typographic error.
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite definition_en as: NIST context: Risk management refers to coordinated activities to direct and control an organization with regard to risk (Source: ISO 31000:2018).

issues.explanation: rejected_fa includes «سنجه», but the editor note itself states that INSO 23684 clause 3.1.1 defines «سنجه» as the official Persian term for 'measure (noun)'. Placing the INSO-defined term for 'measure' in the rejected list of an entry headworded 'Measure' is misleading: a reader will infer «سنجه» is globally wrong for 'measure', when it is the correct INSO term for the noun sense. The rejection conflates two senses under one negative signal.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «سنجه» from rejected_fa. In the editor note, add a cross-reference: «برای مفهوم اسمی سنجه (measure, noun) رجوع شود به مدخل جداگانهٔ آن (INSO 23684 بند ۳.۱.۱)» so readers are directed to the correct entry rather than warned away from a valid INSO term.

issues.explanation: The entry carries zero printed_evidence, meaning no INSO source attests «سنجش» for 'measure'. The editor note explains the term covers the NIST AI RMF MEASURE function, but neither the definition_fa nor the editor note explicitly states that «سنجش» has no INSO attestation. A reader might assume INSO backing exists.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a sentence to editor_note_fa clarifying that «سنجش» is used only in the translated NIST context of this book and is not printed in the cited INSO standards — e.g. «سنجش» در استانداردهای ملی بررسی‌شده چاپ نشده و صرفاً در متن ترجمه‌شدهٔ NIST AI RMF این کتاب به‌کار می‌رود.
